svg.aria-label: A message queue machine on a test bench: a card press (the producer) on the left puts message cards on a roller rack with twelve slots (the queue, head on the right). The broker cabinet takes cards from the head, keeps a copy on its roof shelf of unacknowledged messages with timer dials, and sends each card through a gate and a lane to consumer C1 or C2. A consumer works on the card on its anvil, then sends an ack along a cable to the broker.
